stories.title: For the first time in decades, the U.S. and Russia have no limits on nuclear weapons
stories.summary: The last major arms control treaty between Russian and the U.S. will expire on Thursday, but experts are cautiously optimistic that there won't be another arms race. At least not right away.

stories.title: Lawsuit from families of men killed in boat strikes is the first to reach U.S. court
stories.summary: Relatives of two Trinidadian men killed in a U.S. airstrike last year are suing over what they call extrajudicial killings. It's the first such case to land in an American courthouse.

stories.title: The Trump administration's efforts to end TPS for Haitians was blocked — for now
stories.summary: A federal judge has blocked the Trump administration's efforts to revoke Temporary Protected Status for some 330,000 Haitian immigrants in the U.S., for now.

stories.title: Measles outbreak in South Carolina continues but may be slowing
stories.summary: South Carolina released the newest numbers on its measles outbreak, and there's news of other cases around the country.

stories.title: 'The Washington Post' cuts a third of its staff
stories.summary: The Washington Post is cutting a third of its staff, leading some to say owner Jeff Bezos should sell the company.

stories.title: The auteur of 'Strange Loop' tackles an opera like no other
stories.summary: The Tony Award and Pulitzer Prize winner is trying something new — instead of a musical for Broadway, he's written an opera, now playing in Philadelphia.
